entries.jp: {FFEE}謎の兵士からサンドラを救え！{FFF1}
{v:000C}おい！{n}奴はお前たちで歯の立つ相手ではないぞ。{p}{v:000D}私が直接戦う！{n}お前たちは援護を頼む！
entries.en: {v:000C}Listen! You are no match for him.{p}{v:000D}I shall fight him myself! Give me your support!

entries.jp: {v:000E}みんなが戦いやすいように、使う魔法を選びましょう。{p}{v:000F}一番優先して欲しい魔法を選びなさい。
entries.en: {v:000E}Let us choose which magic I should use to help{n}everyone fight.{p}{v:000F}Choose the magic you would like me to prioritize.

entries.jp: 優先して欲しい魔法はどれですか？
{v:0010}わかりました。{n}そうしましょう。
entries.en: {v:0010}Understood. That is what I shall do.

entries.jp: {v:0011}マスター、もうちょっと我慢してね！
entries.en: {v:0011}Master, hang in there just a little longer!

entries.jp: {v:0012}お母さん、もうちょっとの辛抱よ！
entries.en: {v:0012}Mother, just hold on a little longer!

entries.jp: {v:0013}サンドラ様、後少し待ってください！
entries.en: {v:0013}Sandra-sama, please wait just a little longer!
{v:0014}Please hold on just a little longer!

entries.jp: {v:0018}ん？{n}この感触は‥‥もしや‥‥。{FFF9}{FFFB}{n}{v:0019}俺の腕と目を奪った奴か！？{p}{v:001A}それにしては弱すぎるような‥‥。{n}別人か！？
entries.en: {v:0018}Hm? This feeling... Could it be...{FFF9}{FFFB}{v:0019}The one who took my{n}arm and eyes?!{p}{v:001A}Seems too weak for that... Someone else?!

entries.jp: {v:0016}お前の相手など、私一人で十分だ！
entries.en: {v:0016}I alone am more than enough to deal with you!

entries.jp: {v:001D}！？{p}{v:001E}この消え方‥‥フレッシュゴーレム？
entries.en: {v:001D}?!{p}{v:001E}The way it vanished... A Flesh Golem?

entries.jp: さぁ、次はどうすればいい？
entries.en: Now, what should I do next?

entries.jp: ジュリアンにどう指示しますか？
entries.en: What orders will you give Julian?

entries.jp: {v:0031}では、自由にやらせてもらう！
entries.en: {v:0031}Then I shall fight as I see fit!
